name: RC-B10-0064/2025 – After § 8 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Venezuela following the usurpation of the presidency on the 10th of January 2025
part_text: 8a. Underlines that Maduro’s regime has relied on Cuban military intelligence and state security services to redesign its armed forces and intelligence service to increase its surveillance and repressive apparatus; deplores Venezuela’s alignment with Cuba, Russia, China, Iran, North Korea, Nicaragua and other dictatorial regimes;
